pattern: Post-merge closure artifacts written by Ship without YAML frontmatter (title/date/mode/shipment/feature/pr/merge_commit_sha/compaction_status/closure_status/releasability) reliably draw a Copilot review finding on the closure PR, requiring a fix-reply-resolve cycle. This has now recurred across at least 3 shipments (008-S, 012-S, 013-S). Recommend Ship copy an existing closure doc's frontmatter block as a template at authoring time, before opening the closure PR, rather than relying on Copilot review to catch the omission each time.
